meta.title: beFORE, surf intelligence for the Lisbon coast
meta.description: See which beach is worth it right now. Hourly surf scores for the Lisbon, Ericeira and Cascais coast, computed from open forecast data.
meta.spotDescription: {name} is {word} right now, scoring {score} out of 10. Swell, wind, tide and the hours ahead.
meta.spotDescriptionNoScore: Surf conditions and forecast for {name} on the {region} coast.

spot.honesty: Scores come from open forecast data and a transparent formula, not from anyone's opinion. Rating sessions you actually surfed is what will improve them.
spot.isRightNow: {name} is {word} right now, scoring {score} out of 10.
spot.logHint: Rating what you surfed is what teaches the score.
spot.noForecast: No forecast for this spot yet.
spot.noReadingFor: We have no current reading for {name}.
spot.weakest: {factor} is holding it back. The score only climbs when every factor does.

auth.privateNote: Your logged sessions are private to this account.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured in this build
auth.whySignIn: To log the sessions you surf and rate them. They stay private to your account.
auth.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

log.title: Log a session
log.subtitle: Rate one you actually surfed.
log.thanks: Thanks, that is one more label.
log.signInFirst: Sign in first, so your sessions are saved to your account and stay private to you.
log.anyPastDate: Any past date. Older sessions count just as much.
log.identityLocked: Spot and time identify a session, so they cannot be changed here. Delete it and log it again to move it.
log.checkingConditions: Checking the conditions for that hour
log.forecastOnly: Forecast conditions, not yet confirmed by the archive.
log.noConditions: We hold no conditions for that hour, so this session cannot train the model. Log it anyway if you like, or check the date.
log.ratingHint: 1 is not worth it, 5 is excellent.
log.ratedSummary: {name}, rated {rating} out of 5. It is now part of what the model will learn from.

sessions.title: Your sessions
sessions.empty: Nothing logged yet. Rate a session you surfed and it will show up here.
sessions.confirmDelete: Delete this session? The rating is gone for good.
sessions.dataExplains: We store your email address and the sessions you log. Sessions are private to your account: nobody else can read them, and they are used to teach the score what good surf actually feels like.
sessions.deletionExplains: Deleting your account removes your email and every session with it, immediately and for good.
sessions.confirmAccount: Delete your account and all {count} sessions? This cannot be undone.
